title: Add Teachers and Staff with Roles | AllCoaching
description: Give teachers and staff their own studio login with the right role. Editors build content, Analysts only view, and billing stays with you.
keywords: add teacher in coaching app, multi teacher coaching platform, staff access roles, coaching team management, editor and viewer roles
lede: As your academy grows, bring your teachers and staff into the studio with their own logins. Each person gets a role: Editors create and edit content, Analysts only view, and plan, billing and payouts stay with you as the Owner.
notes: Separate logins for teachers and staff
Billing and payouts stay with the Owner
card: Separate logins for teachers and staff, with Owner, Editor and Analyst roles.

sections.body: The Owner, that is you, can do everything, and there is only one. An Editor can create and edit courses, videos, PDFs and tests, post in the community and see analytics. An Analyst can see analytics, sales and your content, and cannot change anything.
bullets: Owner: plan, billing, payouts, and adding or removing people
Editor: courses, videos, PDFs, tests, community posts and analytics
Analyst: view analytics, sales and content only
The Team page shows how many of your plan's seats are in use
sections.alt: What each role can do: Owner, Editor and Analyst cards with their permissions

sections.body: Press Add a person and answer two questions. Who is it: enter their phone number, and they sign in with that same number, with no link to click and no password. What can they do: Can create and edit for a teacher, Can only view for an accountant or partner.
bullets: Add by phone number, or by email with a join link
Pick the role before you add them
Neither role can see billing or payouts, or add people
Only you can add people to the team
sections.alt: Add a person dialog with a phone number and the Can only view Analyst role selected

sections.body: To change what someone can do, remove them and add them again with the other role. The moment you remove someone, their access to your studio ends.
bullets: Remove ends studio access straight away
Add them again with a new role to change permissions
Your plan, billing and payouts never leave the Owner account
sections.alt: Remove a team member confirmation saying they lose access to the studio straight away

steps.d: Go to Settings, then Team, to see everyone and their roles.
Enter their phone number, or an email to send a join link.
Choose Can create and edit for a teacher, or Can only view for staff who need the numbers.
Remove someone to end access, and add them again to give a new role.

faq.q: How do I add a teacher to my coaching app?
faq.a: In Settings, then Team, press Add a person, enter their phone number and pick a role. They sign in with that number.

faq.q: How do I give staff limited access?
faq.a: Give them the Analyst role; they can view analytics, sales and content but change nothing.

faq.q: How do I keep billing private from my team?
faq.a: Billing, payouts and adding people stay with the Owner; Editors and Analysts cannot see them.

faq.q: How do I change someone's role?
faq.a: Remove them, then add them again with the new role. Removing someone ends their studio access straight away.
